clue.text: Lines appended to mail?

indicators.note: appended to says the lines come after the mail word in the answer

parts.note: post is the mail delivered to your door
a script is written lines, as for actors

explanation.surface: A question about the lines added at the bottom of a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: lines (SCRIPT) tacked onto mail (POST) is exactly what the answer is.
explanation.definitionFit: A PS is extra writing added after the signature of a letter.

clue.text: Poke about university, pleased with oneself

indicators.note: about says the poke word goes around the university letter

parts.note: to prod is to poke

explanation.surface: Someone nosing around a campus, looking smug.
explanation.definitionFit: Being proud of yourself is a synonym for feeling self-satisfied.

clue.text: Pleasure rested on one small dissenting subgroup

parts.note: sat means rested, as on a seat
I is the Roman numeral one
S is the usual abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a faction is a breakaway group within a party

explanation.surface: A political grumble: pleasure depends on one little rebel group.
explanation.definitionFit: Contentment from getting what you wanted is a synonym for pleasure.

clue.text: Hit friends turning up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: pals are friends

explanation.surface: Friends arriving and someone gets struck.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack with the open hand is a kind of blow or strike.

clue.text: One who regrets accepting Doctor of Divinity as guide

indicators.note: accepting says the regretter takes the doctor's letters inside

parts.note: to rue is to regret, so a ruer is one who regrets

explanation.surface: A remorseful person agrees to take a clergyman as mentor.
explanation.definitionFit: The steering blade on a boat directs its course, so figuratively it is a guide.

clue.text: People power unsettled a couple

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

indicators.note: unsettled says the letters of a couple are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: People power has upset a pair of partners.
explanation.definitionFit: The general public of a place is its people, the masses.

clue.text: Towards eleven, company see main point for poisons expert

parts.note: to means towards
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, also a cricket or football team
lo is an old word meaning look or see
the gist is the main point of something

explanation.surface: Near eleven, a firm finds the key point about a poisons specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A scientist who studies toxins and their effects is an expert on poisons.

clue.text: Humour to appear extremely dry

parts.note: to come is to appear or arrive

indicators.note: extremely means take only the extreme letters of dry, its first and last

explanation.surface: Humour that comes across as very dry, deadpan wit.
explanation.definitionFit: Funny drama or entertainment is the genre of humour.

clue.text: Not in hospital room facing away

parts.note: out is the opposite of in
a ward is a room for patients in a hospital

explanation.surface: Discharged from a hospital room, with someone looking away.
explanation.definitionFit: Directed towards the outside is a synonym for facing away from the centre.

clue.text: Picture with sound of enemy trail

indicators.note: sound of says the words are said aloud to give a word spelt differently

parts.note: a foe is an enemy and to tow is to trail behind, giving foe tow

explanation.surface: A picture with sound effects of an enemy trailing someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A snapshot taken by camera is a type of picture.

clue.text: Small amount of speed

definitions.meaning: to hurry or rush, or a sprint

explanation.surface: A small quantity of speed, as if rationing haste.
explanation.definitionFit: One word for both a splash of something added and a quick run.

clue.text: French poet's verse translation of La Reine

definitions.note: read as French poet is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: translation of here means the letters of La Reine are turned into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A French poet's verse version of a piece called La Reine, the queen.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after poet reads as is, joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Verlaine was a nineteenth-century French Symbolist poet.

clue.text: Eternal youth to dwindle and be exhausted (but not out in either case)

indicators.text: but not out in either case
indicators.note: says the word out is dropped from each of the two phrases

parts.note: to peter out is to dwindle away
to pan out, of a mine or seam, is to be worked out or exhausted

explanation.surface: A tale of youth fading, with a parenthetical instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: Both phrasal verbs end in OUT; removing it from each leaves PETER and PAN.
explanation.definitionFit: J. M. Barrie's boy who never grows up is the emblem of eternal youth.

clue.text: Perhaps a bit of snow following a large amount of water

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
a lake is a large body of water

explanation.surface: Snowfall after a lake has frozen over.
explanation.definitionFit: A single crystal of falling snow is an example of a flake, hence perhaps.

clue.text: Cold tailless amphibian atop animal enclosure

indicators.note: in a down clue, atop puts the shortened amphibian above the enclosure
tailless means the amphibian's last letter is cut off

parts.note: a frog is an amphibian
a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: A frog without a tail sits on top of a pigpen in the cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Icy weather with frost is cold; the word also means unfriendly.

clue.text: No cry out for friend

indicators.note: out here means the letters of no cry are put out of order

explanation.surface: Telling someone not to cry out for a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A close pal or chum, often a cosy companion, is a synonym of friend.

clue.text: Screw up masculine point of view

parts.note: M is the grammatical abbreviation for masculine
an angle is a viewpoint or slant on something

explanation.surface: Ruining a man's perspective on things.
explanation.definitionFit: To botch or mess something up badly is to ruin it, a synonym of screw up.

clue.text: Don't hew a yew: some of it is coming up

indicators.note: some of it says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Advice to a gardener not to chop down a yew tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Something approaching or soon to arrive is coming up; the phrase is an idiom for imminent.

clue.text: Vessel in snake pit at last

parts.note: a boa is a large constricting snake

indicators.note: at last means take the final letter of pit

explanation.surface: A ship's hold with a snake in it at last.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship or small craft on water is a vessel.

clue.text: Hang around, covered in pitch

definitions.meaning: smeared with the black sticky substance used on roads

explanation.surface: Someone lingering while coated in tar.
explanation.definitionFit: Two words spelt alike: one means to linger, the other means sticky with tar.

clue.text: People go fast

definitions.meaning: an ethnic group or nation of people

explanation.surface: An instruction for people to move quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a human group sharing ancestry and the act of hurrying.

clue.text: Bad time to bring back group of soldiers

indicators.note: bring back says the combined letters are read in the reverse direction

parts.note: poor means bad, of low quality

explanation.surface: It is a bad time to recall a unit of soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cavalry or armoured unit of soldiers, or any band, is a troop.

clue.text: Window fixer initially gets less inclined to work

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of gets

parts.note: lazier means less willing to work

explanation.surface: A tradesman who starts keen but becomes idler.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman who fits panes of glass into windows.

clue.text: Entry line winding around hotel, essentially

indicators.note: around says the shuffled letters go round the hotel letter
winding means the letters of entry line twist into a new order

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A queue snaking around a hotel entrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winding' rearranges ENTRY LINE into INERENTLY, and 'around' puts that around H.
explanation.definitionFit: Something true by its very nature is true intrinsically, i.e. in its essence.
